text: 金十数据7月16日讯，A股三大指数今日集体下跌，早盘低开后一度回暖，深证成指翻红，午后重回颓势，沪指午后跌破3900点，尾盘三大股指均跌超2%。截至收盘，沪指收跌1.85%，深证成指收跌1.97%，创业板指收跌2.95%；沪深两市成交额超2.4万亿，两市超2300只个股上涨。盘面上，医药板块逆势活跃，影视院线板块低开高走表现强势，半导体产业链集体下挫，其中半导体设备板块持续走弱，圣晖集成连续2日跌停。存储芯片概念延续调整，德明利连续2日跌停，兆易创新跌停。
text_en: Jinshi Data July 16 - A-share three major indices all fell today, recovering briefly after a lower open with the Shenzhen Component Index turning positive, but declining again in the afternoon. The Shanghai Composite fell below 3900 points in the afternoon, and all three indices fell over 2% by the close. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.85%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.97%, and the ChiNext Index fell 2.95%. Shanghai and Shenzhen两市 turnover exceeded 2.4 trillion yuan, with over 2300 stocks rising. By sector, the pharmaceutical sector bucked the trend actively, the film and television sector rose strongly after a lower open, while the semiconductor chain collectively declined, with the semiconductor equipment sector weakening. Sheng Hui Integration (603163) hit limit down for two consecutive days. The memory chip concept continued to adjust, with Demili (300245) hitting limit down for two consecutive days, and GigaDevice hitting limit down.
